inputSchema.name: input
inputSchema.normalization: none — MoveNet's own graph does the [0,255] -> model-internal scaling; do not pre-normalize.
inputSchema._verifiedNote: dtype corrected from an initial uint8 guess to int32 after actually running this exact artifact through onnxruntime-web (Node/WASM) on 2026-09-28 — the graph rejects tensor(uint8) with ERROR_CODE 2 and requires tensor(int32). See model-card.md.

outputSchema.name: output_0
outputSchema.description: 17 COCO keypoints, each [y, x, score], y/x normalized to [0,1] against the 192x192 input.

knownLimitations: Single-person only — does not detect or separate multiple people in frame.
Trained/tuned for a person roughly centered and mostly visible in the 192x192 crop; heavy occlusion or extreme crop degrades keypoint confidence sharply.
int8 quantized artifact: lower keypoint precision than the fp32/fp16 variants at the same input; not yet benchmarked against them in this repo.
Provides 2D image-plane keypoints only — no depth, no 3D pose, no camera-relative scale.

This is a community ONNX re-export (Xenova/movenet-singlepose-lightning) of Google's MoveNet, not Google's own artifact — behavior should be re-verified against the original TF Hub model if discrepancies are suspected.
